1.name: Red Gavan
1.overview:
Reiji Doki, an investigator for the Galaxy Federal Police, is Gavan Infinity—the sole individual in the cosmos authorized to bear the title "Space Sheriff Gavan." Yet he languishes in the marginal Archives Division, enduring daily ridicule from detectives in the First Investigative Division.

Few know his true purpose: investigating trans-dimensional Emorgear crimes.

Reiji now heads for "MultiEarth Λ8018," where an Emorgy Negative Wave threatens to expand across dimensions and potentially collapse the entire universe. Amidst Λ8018's chaos, he encounters Setsuna Aikokuin, captain of the Galaxy Federal Police's Special Forces, but...!

1.name: Twin Blades
1.overview:
Setsuna, known as Gavan Bushido, the Space Sheriff Gavan of MultiEarth Λ8018, confronts Reiji, who has fused with Gavan—a being that shouldn't exist in two forms...

To silence the arrested Hitoshi Kuzumi, the crime syndicate's boss, Karasumaro, attacks Setsuna and his team. As one incident follows another, Setsuna sees Reiji burning with rage toward Karasumaro and...!

1.name: Kiki and Koto
1.overview:
Reiji, pursuing a new Emorgear negative wave, heads to MultiEarth Ι5109. There, he begins investigating an Emorgear incident where humans turn into bubbles, alongside the duo of Kiki Iwai and Kotobuki Takanari from the Galaxy Federal Police's Forensics Division.

As the trio sought the truth behind the incidents, a new Emons attacked them, and Kiki transforms into Gavan Luminous!

1.name: Underground Fortress
1.overview:
On MultiEarth Σ3302, a series of bizarre incidents occur where vital facilities vanish one after another! Reiji, dispatched to the scene, encounters the Galaxy Federal Police investigative duo: Mikuro Arimoto and Shoko Hanemura. Though shocked by Arimoto's seemingly impossible existence, Reiji begins investigating alongside them.

Soon, Reiji and his team arrive at a mysterious underground fortress, only to be attacked by the culprit's drill machine and find themselves in a pinch...!

1.name: Sword and Bullet
1.overview:
Setsuna and Peacekeeping Corps Chief Rui Amou were racing to arrest the smugglers conducting clandestine deals on MultiEarth Λ8018. Amidst this, Amou was abducted by an unknown assailant. Though every moment counted, Headquarters orders Setsuna to stand by...

Conflicted, Setsuna reunites with Reiji, who has crossed dimensions, and is entrusted with something. As the two fight together once more, the secret behind Setsuna's dual-wielding style is revealed...!?

1.name: Phantom Thief Fade Enters
1.overview:
While out shopping on MultiEarth I5109, Kiki and Kotobuki encounter Fuware and Emu, a mother and daughter on the run. Just then, the phantom thief Fade, who is pursuing them, appears, and Kotobuki fights fiercely to protect the two.

In the midst of the chaos, an Emorgear goes haywire, putting Emu in grave danger! With Reiji crossing dimensions to lend a hand, will Kiki and Koto be able to save Emu...!?

1.name: Black Gavan
1.overview:
An incident occurs on MultiEarth A0073. Not only the First Investigation Division, but also Reiji and Colonel Date from the Archives Division rush to the scene. Suddenly, a black Gavan appears, and the colonel is injured. Reiji sees the figure of his former senior, Taito Gato, superimposed on the colonel...!?

Reiji, who has been harboring anger for quite some time, fights Death Gavan even as he is battered and bruised...!

1.name: The Shooter with Magic Bullets
1.overview:
A series of mysterious runaway incidents has occurred on MultiEarth ∧8018. The runaways appear to be caused by long-range sniping by a Nega Emorgy. Setsuna, recalling a man who once served as a sniper during an interstellar war long ago, begins an investigation alongside Reiji and AGI, who have rushed across dimensions to join him.

As the investigation progresses, an Emons attacks and Setsuna transforms, but the sniper’s bullet targets Gavan Bushido…!!

1.name: Crisis in the Forensics Division
1.overview: In order to have the words of the previously missing Emorgear Yukaida analyzed, Reiji heads to the Galaxy Federal Police Forensic Division on MultiEarth Ι5109. There, Kiki and Kotobuki are in the middle of a huge fight for some reason. Just then, a new species of Emons that multiplies infinitely appears, putting Earth Ι5109 in danger of destruction!? Even in the midst of this emergency, Kiki and Kotobuki continue to fight, and to their surprise, even the Phantom Thief Fade shows up...

1.name: Ninja Gavan
1.overview: On MultiEarth A0073, Reiji and his team head out to inspect the Cosmo Gavarion’s new enhancement unit. Just as they marvel at the dragon-themed unit, Space Sheriff Gavan Raiya—Kunai Kazanami—suddenly appears, dressed like a ninja, and attacks them. If he came from another dimension, does that mean Kunai is a dimension-hopper like Reiji...!? Reiji transforms into Gavan Infinity and clashes fiercely with Gavan Raiya...!

1.name: Dimensional Ninja Scroll
1.overview: After escaping from the interrogation room on MultiEarth A0073, Kunai takes Reiji with him and crosses dimensions to MultiEarth Z2066. Waiting for them there was the Galactic Syndicate Bai Akube, the greatest enemy of the Galaxy Federal Police. In exchange for bringing Reiji with him, Kunai had made “a certain promise” to the leader, Rurugie…!? Soon, Kunai and Reiji engage in a massive brawl within Bai Akube’s impregnable giant fortress. Kunai’s heart is shaken by Reiji’s fearless fighting style…

1.name: Samurai and Ninja
1.overview: During a conversation with Reiji and the others, Setsuna begins to wonder if he, as an android, might actually have emotions. “If that’s the case…” he thinks, and tries various methods to see if he can perform the act of crying—something he has secretly longed to do—but since he lacks the structural “tear-shedding function,” he fails every single time. "In that case..." Setsuna heads to the "Gathering of Those Who Long for Tears," where he finds Kunai, who has crossed dimensions to meet the other Gavan. Finally, the samurai and ninja Gavan come face to face, but...!?

1.name: The Gavan Kidnapping Case
1.overview:
Kiki has been kidnapped by someone!? Relying on the Kanky Emorgear left behind at the scene of her disappearance, Kotobuki begins the search. Kunai, who has crossed dimensions to arrive on MultiEarth I5109, also joins the investigation.

Just then, another emergency arises. To save Kiki, who is acting strangely—unlike her usual self—Kunai transforms into Gavan Raiya and unleashes a surprising new ninja technique!

1.name: The Truth of the Universe
1.overview:
Death Gavan suddenly reappears, and Reiji fights alongside Setsuna and Kunai. However, Reiji and the others are no match for his overwhelming strength. Then, Death Gavan deactivates his V-Suit. Tesshin Mikage reveals his true purpose to Reiji and invites him, saying, “Come with me, Infinity”…!?

As a massive battle erupts, Gavan and the others chase after Death Gavan and plunge into the Maque Space…!

1.name: Patran's Decision
1.overview:
A series of mysterious building bombings has occurred on MultiEarth A0073. Patran, who has successfully passed Gavan’s tests, is fired up to solve this case and earn himself a major achievement. When he rushes to the scene, he finds not only the First Investigative Division there, but also Reiji and Date from the Records Division for some reason...

Just then, a new bomb threat arrives from the culprit. With the deadline approaching and neither the culprit nor the bomb in sight, Patran makes “a certain decision”…!

1.name: Runaway Space Express
1.overview: Detecting a new wave of negative Emorgy, Reiji travels across dimensions to MultiEarth Φ5791. On Φ5791, where trains travel through outer space, humanity has been digitized, and the conductors are robots. Just then, an AI malfunction causes the space railroad to go into a runaway spree. Amid this crisis, Reiji transforms into Gavan Infinity and attempts to stop the runaway train by teaming up with the only Space Sheriff Gavan on MultiEarth Φ5791...!?

1.name: For the Sake of Smiles
1.overview:
Kiki and Kotobuki have finally arrested the elusive master thief Fade. Just as they begin questioning him in the interrogation room, they receive word that a massive meteorite is rapidly approaching Earth. Reiji also rushes across dimensions to MultiEarth I5109, but the meteorite is simply too massive for him to do anything about it...

In the midst of this critical situation, Kiki—who fights to bring smiles to everyone’s faces—notices something. As the deadline approaches, the “Greatest and Mightiest Guardian Deity” descends...!?

1.name: Someone Special
1.overview:
Setsuna and Rui find themselves conducting an undercover investigation at a bizarre matchmaking party on MultiEarth Λ8018. Reiji also rushes to the scene from another dimension, and the three of them, in disguise, begin making contact with the suspicious attendees. Just then, a mysterious queen wearing a mask appears, and the party venue turns into a “battlefield of love swirling with desire”…!?

Amidst all this, Setsuna’s “time-transcending feelings”—driven by his determination to protect what he holds dear—are revealed.

1.name: Koto and Kiki
1.overview: A hostage situation breaks out at the academy where Kiki and Kotobuki once attended. The two head to their alma mater, where they reunite with their former teacher, Miya Sakaura. Kiki attempts to negotiate with the hostage-taker but is shot and finds herself in a life-or-death situation! Faced with a critical decision, what will Kotobuki do…!? Meanwhile, Reiji attempts to cross dimensions and head to MultiEarth I5109, but finds himself trapped in the Maque Space...

1.name: Because of Love
1.overview: “The Truth of the Universe,” Aza Zorth, has a certain number of worshippers in each dimension, including Death Gavan. These prisoner-worshippers have been released into the world. Meanwhile, Reiji has finally crossed dimensions to arrive at MultiEarth I5109, where he learns of the events that befell Kiki and Kotobuki. Suddenly, he is swallowed up by the Maque Space and finds himself fighting Death Gavan and the escaped prisoners. As he desperately tries to rescue Kiki and the others as quickly as possible, Death Gavan makes him “a certain proposal”…

1.name: Gavans Assemble
1.overview: Finally, the forces of Aza Zorth have begun to move in earnest, and “Negapools” are erupting one after another on MultiEarth A0073. If this continues, the damage will spread throughout the galaxy, triggering the “Emorgy Syndrome”—a phenomenon where people’s anxiety invites even greater calamities.. Reiji steps up to try to stop the Emorgy Syndrome, but he finds himself cornered by rampaging soldiers, Emons, and the Maque Spaces that keep appearing one after another. Just as he feels he’s reached his limit fighting alone, the other Gavans gather from across dimensions. They’re about to perform a miracle that will change destiny…!

1.name: Jo-Chaku
1.overview:
A few days after the Death Gavan Fleet Invasion Incident, the escaped convicts resumed their evil activities across various dimensions. To stop them, Setsuna, Kiki, and Kunai each find themselves fighting their respective arch-enemies. However, with the Gavan System shut down, they are unable to transform into Gavan, leaving them in a dire predicament...

Meanwhile, Reiji, who was also in the midst of battle, was suddenly enveloped in a bright light and found himself face-to-face with the Supreme Chancellor in a mysterious space...

1.name: Infinity
1.overview: With the order to shut down the Gavan System lifted, Reiji, Setsuna, Kiki, and Kunai once again transform into Gavan. As each of them prepares to settle the score with their arch-enemies, Reiji—who has been entrusted with the emotions of the “higher dimension”—finally faces off against Death Gavan in a one-on-one battle. Soon, memories of his past with Gato resurface, and as Reiji fights across dimensions, the voices of his comrades reach him...

2.name: Awaken! Red Kakuzyu King!
2.overview:
Shout the Fiery, a treasure hunter well-versed in ancient scripts, spends his days deciphering ancient manuscripts, setting out on expeditions, and unearthing ancient artifacts. One day, while exploring an ancient ruin, Shout discovers the “Kakuzyu Awakener Omegahorn” and the “Egorgears” Though puzzled by the Omegahorn—which differs from the Kakuzyu Awakeners used by modern hunters—he tries setting the Egorgear into it, and a giant horned beast named Enkaku appears!

Enkaku recognizes the qualities of a “King” in Shout’s ego (his unwavering resolve to follow his own path) and, calling himself “Captain Omegahorn,” demands that Shout fight alongside him…!?

2.name: Show Me! Captain's Qualifications!
2.overview:
Twin hunters—Ail the Bold and All the Upright—are asked for help in a certain town. It turns out the townspeople have been swindled out of their treasure by a con artist. To reclaim the treasure, Ail and All challenge the con artist to a Hunter Battle, but find themselves in a desperate, life-or-death situation. Just then, Shout and Enkaku rush to their aid...

Meanwhile, the Ibaru Alliance, led by Ibaru of Despair, was heading toward the western territories to subdue a group of armed hunters running amok...

2.name: Savor It! The Furious Tag Battle!
2.overview:
Giriko the Wave-Slasher—who had been watching Shout and the others fight—challenged them to a Hunter Battle! However, the battle was interrupted by hunters from the Ibaru Alliance who suddenly appeared. Shout and Giriko were captured and taken to the “Egorgear Quarry”...

At the mining site, many residents were being forced to mine under grueling conditions. Shout forms an impromptu tag team with Giriko, and they end up facing the Ibaru Alliance hunters in a 2-on-2 battle...!

2.name: Unleash Them! Enkaku vs. Zankaku!
2.overview:
By saving the residents of Scovilla, Shout finds himself on a collision course with the Ibaru Alliance. He declares that if anyone gets in the way of his beloved treasure hunts, he’ll just knock them out. Amidst all this, Shout faces off against Giriko in another Hunter Battle. If he loses this battle, will his “contract” with Enkaku come to an end!? And it seems Giriko has a plan of her own…

Meanwhile, Reiji is also ordered by Ibaru to participate in a Hunter Battle!!

2.name: Find It! Your Own Unique Ego!
2.overview:
Shout reunites with Ail and All, who ask him about a mysterious flying Kakuzyu called “Nazokaku.” Nazokaku isn’t listed in the Kakuzyu Encyclopedia, and it seems even Enkaku doesn’t know about it. They all decide to search for Nazokaku, but All alone looks somewhat downcast…

Eventually, the group enters a cave where Enkaku had picked up a mysterious scent. There, they encounter hunters from the Ibaru Alliance, and Shout and the others are attacked and left unable to move. In the midst of this dire crisis, All—the only one still unharmed—takes on the hunters in battle, but…!?

2.name: Break Through! The House of Gluttony!
2.overview:
Shout arrives in the town of Kouha to sell some ancient artifacts. There, he meets Seiyu, a boy who says he’s been separated from his mother. Unable to leave Seiyu in distress, Shout sets out to help him find his mother, but ends up getting into a fight with Enkaku…!?

Eventually, Shout arrives at a strange Western-style mansion, where he meets Touna, the town’s lord and a hunter with an eccentric appetite. However, with Enkaku absent, Shout takes on a Hunter Battle and finds himself in a dire predicament…!

2.name: Break Through! Enkaku vs. Zetsu-Enkaku!
2.overview:
Shout and Enkaku visit a hot spring town in the Ibaru Domain. While searching for anyone being tormented by Ibaru, Enkaku senses something ominous. Emerging from beyond the steam was Zetsu-Enkaku. From a single remark, a shocking truth about Enkaku and Zetsu-Enkaku is revealed...

Shout and the others, having followed Zetsu-Enkaku, finally come face-to-face with Ibaru. They challenge him to a Hunter Battle, but...!?

2.name: Revive! Ancient Weapons!
2.overview:
After losing a Hunter Battle to Ibaru, Shout lost consciousness. When he woke up, Genno the Shattering Calamity—who had taken an interest in Shout—challenged him to a Hunter Battle. Faced with Genno’s fierce hammer attacks, Shout was forced to play purely defensive…

Meanwhile, Ibaru begins experiments with an “ancient excavated weapon” revived by Dr. Techno. He forces Reiji to pilot the weapon and makes him fight Enkaku…!?

2.name: Shape the Era! Shout vs. Enkaku!
2.overview: After losing his battle against Genno, Shout has nowhere left to turn. However, he seems to have gained some insight and begins intensive training with Giriko and the others. To reclaim Enkaku, he challenges Ibaru to another Hunter Battle. Then, Ibaru orders Enkaku to fight Shout... Will Shout win the battle and reclaim Enkaku!?

2.name: Ignite Your Fighting Spirit! Captain Ail!
2.overview:
Having defeated Ibaru, Shout and his companions are welcomed in the village where they stop. Just then, Ail and All’s childhood friend, Chatsumi, arrives seeking help.

It turns out that Chatsumi’s father and the other men of the village have been kidnapped by a hunter named Zu Shin the Blazing and are being forced into labor.

Determined to save Chatsumi and the others, Ail becomes Captain Ail and challenges Zu Shin to a “Hell Hunter Battle”!

2.name: Shatter! The Wall That Stands in Our Way!
2.overview:
Shout and his companions arrive in Inboca, the “Blessed Town,” which has long been at war with the Ibaru Alliance. After defeating the Ibaru Alliance hunters who were terrorizing the residents, they are treated to a lavish feast by the town’s leader, Warren. On top of that, they’re recruited as the town’s bodyguards…!?

Soon after, Shout runs into Reiji. They engage in a Hunter Battle, with “something” Shout happened to come across serving as the prize!

2.name: Take It Back! Giriko vs. Baasaa!
2.overview: Baggins has been transformed into a monstrous form by Zetsu-Enkaku. As Shout and the others battle to protect the people from Baggins, who is rampaging through a certain town, Giriko appears on the scene. It turns out this town is Suno—the hometown of “Kanna the Illuminating Guide,” whom Giriko has been searching for. Furthermore, Baasaa the Soaring Guide also appears in Suno to subdue Baggins… Giriko faces off against Baasaa—who claims to have “erased Kanna”—in a fated Hunter Battle.

2.name: Come Forth! Visitors From Another World!
2.overview:
Shout and the others have become heroes for defeating the Kakuzyu-Ningen and are now being thanked by the townspeople. Suddenly, a mysterious flying mecha appears before them. As Shout and the others give chase, they come across a scene where Daisuke Date and AGI are about to be taken away by hunters from the Ibaru Alliance. Determined to save the two, they challenge the hunters to a battle.

Meanwhile, around the same time, Ibaru and Reiji had also begun a Hunter Battle in an effort to have a heart-to-heart talk…!

2.name: Defend! Hunters vs. Mecha Enkaku!
2.overview:
The mysterious mechanical Kakuzyu activated by Warren has set off toward the Ibaru Alliance’s castle town. The Alliance’s hunters attempt to stop its advance but are wiped out… As Ibaru steps up to face this crisis, Shout and the others rush to the scene.

Furthermore, Reiji, who joined the fight to protect the town, appears before Daisuke and AGI...!

2.name: Rise Up! Red Hero!
2.overview:
The Maque Space created by Zetsu-Enkaku mutates into a giant Emons. Reiji, who has transformed into Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity, steps up to face it. Shout and the others are shocked by the sudden revelation of Reiji’s true identity. Amidst this, a massive fleet of Ark Gavarion Crimson appears, and though Shout and Enkaku fight back, they find themselves in dire straits.

Just as Shout rises to defend their world even while cornered, Enkaku and the Mecha Enkaku, which was supposed to have shut down—merge, giving birth to Cho Kakuseiyo Omega Enkaku!

overview: Since 1975, Japan’s iconic Super Sentai series has defined the tokusatsu landscape. Now, after 50 years, Japan’s weekly tokusatsu broadcasting timeslot will welcome a brand-new project by Toei titled, PROJECT R.E.D. (short for Records of Extraordinary Dimensions). PROJECT R.E.D. is a new tokusatsu series featuring a red hero in action.

seasons.name: Super Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity
seasons.overview: The story unfolds in the worldview of multiverse theory, where there is not just one universe. In the overlapping multiverses labelled as "Cosmo Layers", there exist other Earths that are identical to the Earth we live on. Gavan Infinity is a Space Sheriff who can transcend dimensions. What kind of cases will he solve in the diverse dimensions he is set in, and why can he transcend dimensions? A new Gavan legend never before seen begins!

title: PROJECT R.E.D.
